Interface SparPilot

All Known Implementing Classes:
BotPilot, SparLearnSession
public interface SparPilot
Whatever plays the fake player while a person spars against it: the trained network as it is (BotPilot), or the network while it also learns from the fight.

Handed over from the client thread, then used by the server thread only.
